title: Usiku nilikula ramen na kuku wa kukaanga kando ya Mto Han mjini Seoul
label: Mto Han Usiku

text.In Seoul, Korea, there is a river called: Huko Seoul, Korea Kusini, kuna mto unaoitwa Han (Hangang).
text.Drinking beer, eating chicken, and eatin: Kunywa bia, kula kuku na ramen kando ya mto huo.
text.It seems that Korea has that kind of cul: Inaonekana Korea ina utamaduni wa aina hiyo.
text.I did the thing I had seen in Korean dra: Nilifanya jambo nililokuwa nimeliona kwenye tamthilia za Kikorea.
text.By the Han River, there is a chicken sho: Kando ya Mto Han kuna duka la kuku linaloitwa bhc.
text.There was a convenience store under it,: Kulikuwa na duka dogo chini yake, kwa hiyo nilinunua ramen ya kikombe hapo.
text.In the park, there is a special machine: Bustani hiyo ina mashine maalum ya kutengeneza ramen ya kikombe, iliyowekwa hapo tu.
text.When you follow the machine's instructio: Ukifuata maelekezo ya mashine na kuongeza maji ya moto, ramen ya kikombe huwa tayari.
text.Like that, I wash down cup ramen and fri: Hivyo ndivyo nilivyokula ramen ya kikombe na kuku wa kukaanga huku nikinywa bia.
text.There was even a trash can just for rame: Kulikuwa hata na pipa maalum la vikombe vya ramen, jambo lililonivutia.
text.🗑 A trash can just for ramen cups: 🗑 Pipa maalum la vikombe vya ramen
text.What surprised me was that even though I: Nilishangaa kwamba sehemu za kukaa zilikuwa karibu zimejaa ingawa nilifika karibu saa nne au tano usiku.
text.Besides the seats, many people had also: Mbali na viti, watu wengi walikuwa wameleta mikeka ya pikiniki.
text.In the Japanese way of thinking, people: Kwa mtazamo wa Kijapani, watu hawaendelei kukaa na kuzungumza bustanini hadi karibu saa nne au tano usiku.
text.I was surprised that so many people were: Nilishangaa kuona watu wengi bustanini hata wakati huo wa usiku.
text.I thought, \"Korean people stay in the p: Nilifikiri, “Wakorea hukaa bustanini hadi saa tano usiku na kuzungumza sana hivi.”
text.In a survey asking \"What do you do on w: Katika utafiti uliouliza “Unafanya nini wikendi na siku za mapumziko?”, Wakorea wengi walijibu, “Ninatumia muda na watu muhimu kwangu na marafiki.”
text.I once saw that kind of survey result in: Niliwahi kuona matokeo ya utafiti kama huo kwenye habari.
text.(※Maybe I saw it in a news article like: (※Labda niliona katika habari kama “Wajapani hupendelea kutumia muda peke yao.” Ilikuwa ipi tena?)
text.The Korean people there were probably dr: Huenda Wakorea waliokuwapo walikuwa wamelewa na walikuwa wakizungumza sana bustanini.
text.Of course, it is a foreign language, so: Bila shaka ni lugha ya kigeni, kwa hiyo sijui wanachosema.
text.My image is that English has cool pronun: Kwa maoni yangu, matamshi ya Kiingereza husikika ya kuvutia.
text.I do not know if they are angry, or mayb: Sijui kama walikuwa wamekasirika au labda wakilalamika kuhusu kazi.
text.They are talking very fast and strongly: Walikuwa wakizungumza Kikorea kwa kasi na kwa msisitizo.
Kusikia tu mandhari hiyo kulikuwa kwa namna fulani kufurahisha.
